## Analysis overview

Combines analysis-ready chemistry and hematology records, counts baseline and analysis normal-range combinations by parameter and treatment, calculates percentages, and performs stratified CMH comparisons when estimable.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBC`
- `ADLBH`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: laboratory parameter
- `BNRIND`: baseline normal-range indicator
- `ANRIND`: analysis normal-range indicator
- `ANL01FL`: analysis-record flag
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment.
